Test Case Description: Verify Group Bank Details screen loads successfully
Preconditions: User is authenticated and can open Group Maintenance submodules
Test Steps: 1. Open Group Maintenance | 2. Open Data Entry > Center Bank Details | 3. Wait for iframe page load
Expected Result: Group Bank Details page loads with no blocking errors and all main sections are visible

Test Case Description: Verify page header actions are visible
Preconditions: Group Bank Details screen is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Observe header area | 2. Verify Refresh and Close buttons are present
Expected Result: Header shows title icon refresh and close controls with proper tooltips

Test Case Description: Verify module ID hidden value is present
Preconditions: Screen is loaded from parent module
Test Steps: 1. Inspect hidden input moduleId_group_bank_details
Expected Result: Module ID hidden field is populated with query value or default 100

Test Case Description: Verify Account Type dropdown population
Preconditions: Screen is loaded with ViewData options
Test Steps: 1. Open Account Type dropdown | 2. Review options list
Expected Result: Dropdown shows --Select-- and configured account type options

Test Case Description: Verify Institution Type dropdown population
Preconditions: Screen is loaded with ViewData options
Test Steps: 1. Open Institution Type dropdown | 2. Review options list

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads existing group bank accounts
Preconditions: Group context exists with saved bank details

Expected Result: Existing bank details are retrieved and shown in list and relevant fields

Test Case Description: Verify Add action enables form fields for entry
Preconditions: Screen is loaded in default mode

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action requires an existing selected record
Preconditions: No table row is selected

Preconditions: No table row is selected
